# Colecto v0.10.1

Desktop installers are back for Linux, Windows, and macOS, alongside faster CI and Docker builds.

## Packaging

- **Linux (`x64`, `arm64`)**: Added `.deb`, `.rpm`, and `.AppImage` packages alongside the `.tar.gz` bundle. All packages include `colecto-daemon` and `colecto-mcp`.
- **Windows (`x64`)**: Added a per-user `.exe` installer (no admin prompt required by default) alongside the portable `.zip`.
- **macOS (`arm64`)**: Switched from `.tar.gz` to a drag-to-Applications `.dmg` image (`colecto-daemon` and `colecto-mcp` are bundled inside `Colecto.app/Contents/MacOS/`).

## Build & CI

- Cached Rust dependencies in the daemon Docker image using `cargo-chef` and shared GitHub Actions BuildKit caches across CI and release workflows.
- Added Pub package, Linux `arm64` Flutter SDK, and `mold` linker caching/optimizations across release builds.
